Showing the unstable beginning of getting my Buprenorphine (Suboxone) refills at the local ERs as the November 4, 2025 L.A. Care grievance
addressed. 3 day supply...7 day supply...10 day supply...Tarzana Treatment Centers (320 E Palmdale Blvd, Palmdale, CA 93550) advised me that

I could enroll into their Suboxone program but would be discharged if anything but Suboxone showed in a random toxicology screen after a

of couple months. I informed them that I was on Alprazolam (Xanax) at the time and asked if they could help me taper down. They stated that
they did not do outpatient benzo tapering and that their inpatient program was the only way that I could get any assistance with that.
